annotation_type: Anatomical coordinate envelopes defining the olfactory deposition ROI
annotation_rationale: Superior nasal roof and adjacent upper septal/lateral walls, behind the external face and anterior to the nasopharynx. Native-coordinate sagittal and coronal views define the envelopes. Three fixed Y thresholds provide narrow, standard, and wide ROI masks.

spray.breathing: Breath hold with prescribed quiescent background air
spray.pitch_definition: Elevation from posterior +X toward superior +Y in native coordinates
spray.yaw_definition: Azimuth of the axis projection in the native XZ plane; positive toward +Z (medially for this negative-Z nostril)
spray.nozzle_model: Virtual point nozzle in the negative-Z nostril with a fixed tip and angle-dependent breakup plane
study_assumptions: tip location selected inside this geometry
